review: Do not use McDelivery. They outsource a courier so if there's an issue with your order, you have to try and take it up with McDonalds rather than the courier app you would have used in the first place. Very disappointed overall and unfortunately, the only way to be heard is to leave negative reviews. I spent $60 on hasbrowns and burnt coffee.
I do not need to enable wifi scanning to look at the menu. This is spyware behaviour. ridiculous
